metadata.purpose: Automate one shared legacy ConnectableObservable connection while the subscriber count is nonzero.

conditions: At most one connection is live while the registry contains subscribers.
The last unsubscribe disconnects the producer; an overlapping join does not reconnect or replay.
An upstream terminal notification is broadcast to current subscribers; the fixed publish Subject retains completion/error for late subscribers.

scope.parameters: Legacy pipeable refCount() following publish() / ConnectableObservable with one fixed Subject, immediate disconnect when count reaches zero; terminal Subject is retained.
scope.callbacks: No custom Subject factory, selection callback or user callback evaluation.
scope.time: No clock: connection lifetime is determined by ordered subscribe/unsubscribe and producer notifications.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-setup subscriber registration; each subscription occurrence has a unique ID.
exclusions: Calling refCount on an ordinary non-Connectable Observable or custom ConnectableObservable implementations.
Synchronous source completion/next during connect() and the local connection-identity teardown race.
Custom Subject variants, manual external connect/disconnect during refCount, reentrant observers and throwing teardown.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe observer to ConnectableObservable Subject before connecting the producer on first use.

ownership.sharing: All refCount subscribers of this published ConnectableObservable share one source connection.
ownership.reset: Last departing observer closes the connection. Terminal completion/error is retained on the fixed Subject, preventing reconnection after terminal.

dispatch.actionSemantics: The wrapper decrements the source refcount on finalization. The same guarded transitions as share with refcount-zero reset but retained terminal states apply within this profile.
cancellationCheckpoints: A non-last observer leave does not close the producer.
Last leave disconnects silently; late joins start a new connection.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID and available connection generation
actions: subscribe to the source under a fresh connection generation
rules.nextState: one registered subscriber and one connection
rules.explanation: Constructing the shared Observable starts nothing. Its first subscriber creates a Subject-backed connection to the source; that connection is shared by overlapping subscribers.

rules.nextState: append subscriber to the existing connection, without replay
rules.explanation: A subscriber joining a live connection receives future values, not past values. It does not create another source subscription. Sharing is not replay.

actions: forward the value to each currently registered subscriber in registration order
rules.explanation: A source value is forwarded unchanged to each currently subscribed observer. With no observers, a retained connection can still receive values, but share stores none of them.

rules.guard: registered subscriber and at least one other remains
rules.explanation: When one subscriber leaves while others remain, remove only that subscriber. The shared source continues and no completion is sent to the departing observer.

rules.guard: the last registered subscriber leaves; resetOnRefCountZero=true
rules.nextState: reset the connection with no live subscribers
rules.explanation: When the last subscriber leaves a nonterminated connection, resetOnRefCountZero=true disconnects and resets it. A future subscriber starts a new source execution. No completion notification is synthesized.

actions: send complete to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: retain terminal status with no live connection or registered subscribers
rules.explanation: On source complete, notify current subscribers and release that source connection. The retained Subject remains terminated; future subscribers receive only that terminal notification and do not reconnect.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID; retained terminal Subject
actions: send the cached complete to this subscriber only
rules.nextState: remain terminated without connecting or retaining the new subscriber
rules.explanation: A subscriber arriving after retained complete immediately receives that complete, with no replayed value and no new source connection.

actions: send error to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: retain terminal status with no live connection or registered subscribers
rules.explanation: On source error, notify current subscribers and release that source connection. The retained Subject remains terminated; future subscribers receive only that terminal notification and do not reconnect.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID; retained terminal Subject
actions: send the cached error to this subscriber only
rules.nextState: remain terminated without connecting or retaining the new subscriber
rules.explanation: A subscriber arriving after retained error immediately receives that error, with no replayed value and no new source connection.
